exercises.prompt: Choose the sentence that means “These books are not at home.” In an office. Use the supplied subject nämä kirjat (“these books”) and kotona (“at home”).
exercises.explanation: Nämä kirjat is plural and therefore takes eivät ole.

sentenceExplanation.translation: These books are not at home.
sentenceExplanation.pattern: demonstrative noun phrase subject + negative verb carrying number agreement + main verb after the negative verb + location

parts.formation: the complete plural subject is supplied
third-person plural form

parts.role: main verb after the negative verb
parts.formation: fixed form after the negative verb
unchanged location word

Correct. Nämä kirjat is plural and therefore takes eivät ole.
“ei” is the singular negative verb; use “eivät”, the plural negative verb.
“ovat” is the plural affirmative form of olla; use “eivät”, the plural negative verb.
“ovat” is the plural affirmative form of olla; use “ole”, the main verb form required after the negative verb.
